units.passage: Addressing the issue with transparency about your suspicion can help influence a more thorough response from the student.

units.passage: This faculty guide provides conversation starters and practical strategies to help instructors thoughtfully discuss artificial intelligence with students, including setting expectations, encouraging AI literacy, and promoting responsible use in coursework. Addressing Learning Challenges with AI This faculty guide highlights how generative AI can help address common student learning challenges by supporting brainstorming, organizing ideas, understanding difficult concepts, and revising written work. It provides practical examples of how students can use AI to enhance learning while still engaging in critical thinking, communication, and the development of academic skills. Academic Integrity and AI This faculty guide provides a practical framework for addressing concerns about student use of generative AI and academic integrity, emphasizing evidence gathering, supportive conversations, and thoughtful questioning before pursuing formal misconduct processes.
units.why: The guide stresses 'supportive conversations... before pursuing formal misconduct processes', i.e., talking to the student before escalating (P57).

units.passage: Educators are strongly encouraged to make reasonable attempts to discuss the situation with the student before they submit.
units.why: Educators are 'strongly encouraged to... discuss the situation with the student before they submit', which is talk before escalating (P57).

units.passage: The student should be made aware of the situation. This can be done via email or in person. Simply outline how you came to the conclusion of academic dishonesty and what your next steps will be.
